name: claude-code-plugin
description: Mods for Claude Code: a prompt-cache countdown with keepalive, a reviewer subagent, and a to-do list the agent keeps for you.

plugins.name: cachier
plugins.description: Prompt-cache time left as a pie on the footer, opt-in keepalive pings, costs in dollars or tokens, and a time on every message.

plugins.name: auditor
plugins.description: A persistent reviewer subagent that audits each worker turn and hands its corrections back to the worker.

plugins.name: human-plugin
plugins.description: A to-do list for the user, kept by the agent and pinned above the prompt until the human marks each item done.
